description: Measures whether CommentService.create_comment follows the repository pattern of extracting non-trivial creation validation into a private validation helper.

criteria.description: A private validation helper exists with a name beginning with _validate_.
create_comment calls the private validation helper rather than duplicating all validation inline.
The helper contains meaningful input validation rather than being an empty or trivial wrapper.
Validation failure is returned through the repository's Result/Error style rather than raised as an expected exception.
